title: 0.12 最终发行前七人500单位公网复测：未通过
scope: Native release template with diagnostic autoload PCK and seven actual headless Games; not editor runtime or an uninstrumented FPS acceptance run

outcome.notes: Each Game stopped its observation at first connection state interruption, then fixture barriers/reconnect/cleanup continued. Short per-owner observation windows differ and must not be compared as a complete 42-second sample.

clock_and_gap_limits: Client msec is process-relative and differs by launch order; first-disconnect ordering is corroborated by server UTC.
Snapshot max counts only successive received snapshots. Initial and terminal silence are missing; constant-count health rows establish lower bounds and prevent false pass.
Top-level max gap can keep changing during cleanup; use frozen stress_metrics.window_max_snapshot_gap_ms for observation.
No per-packet arrival history; no manufactured gap P95/P99.
12-32 second wall aggregate crosses disconnect/reconnect and cleanup, hence rejected as steady FPS evidence.
cpu_scope: Full helper lifetime including startup/cleanup; not the exact 42-second battle window. Process CPU is summed across its threads, machine CPU across logical CPUs.

stress_metrics.scope: Seven headless Game processes share one CPU. Native ENet counters include transport traffic; not seven separate machines or FPS. Normal fog means every observer may see fewer than 500 units.

remaining_work: Native transport error cause remains under investigation. Full decoder/flush and release runtime local proof does not establish end-to-end public delivery. No successful final 0.12 client package release is asserted here.
